Co-op, AI for Protein Design

San Francisco, CA USA

Your Impact at LILA

This PhD-level co-op will join the Life Science AI team to contribute to applied ML research in protein engineering, including generative protein design, antibody engineering, developability, and wet-lab-informed model iteration. Working alongside Lila scientists and ML researchers, the co-op will explore generative and predictive models for protein sequence, structure, and function, analyze biological and experimental datasets to evaluate model outputs, and prototype workflows that connect model predictions, candidate prioritization, and wet-lab feedback. Results will be communicated through code, notebooks, written summaries, and presentations.

The ideal candidate is a currently enrolled PhD student in CS, ML, computational biology, bioengineering, biophysics, or a related field, with research experience in ML or protein engineering, strong Python skills, and experience with frameworks like PyTorch or JAX. Familiarity with protein language models, diffusion or flow-based models, antibody design, or active learning workflows is a plus.

The role advances our domain-specific protein design models while the data, methods, and evaluation tools built along the way also strengthen our general AI research model, directly supporting Lila’s mission of combining automated data generation with scientific superintelligence.

What You'll Be Building



- Research generative and predictive models for protein and antibody design
- Analyze experimental datasets to evaluate model outputs and guide design decisions
- Prototype workflows linking model predictions, candidate prioritization, and wet-lab feedback
- Build datasets and benchmarks that support both domain-specific and general AI research models
- Share results through code, notebooks, and presentations

What You'll Need To Succeed



- Currently enrolled PhD student in CS, ML, computational biology, bioengineering, biophysics, or a related field
- Research experience in machine learning, computational biology, or protein engineering
- Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch, JAX, or similar frameworks
- Experience working with biological sequence, structure, or assay data
- Clear communication and comfort collaborating with cross-disciplinary teams

Bonus Points For



- Experience with protein language models, structure prediction, or generative design (diffusion or flow-based models)
- Familiarity with antibody design, developability, or wet-lab validation concepts
- Publications, preprints, or open-source work in ML for biology

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

A Note to Agencies

Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

Job Details

Job Description:

What if your next project helped power the future of technology?

At Intel, you'll do more than learn, you'll contribute. You'll work side-by-side with industry leaders, gain hands-on experience on meaningful projects, and help solve real-world challenges that affect billions of people worldwide. From advanced semiconductor manufacturing to AI-powered innovations, you'll play a role in technologies that redefine how the world works, learns, and connects.

What makes Intel unique is the opportunity to see the entire technology lifecycle in action. Unlike many companies where hardware, software, and manufacturing operate separately, Intel brings them together, giving you exposure to everything from research and design to advanced semiconductor manufacturing and global deployment.

Whether you're tackling engineering challenges, improving operations, analyzing data, advancing next-generation technologies, or supporting global customers, you'll build valuable skills while contributing to innovations that enable a more sustainable and connected future.

Bring your curiosity, make an impact, and see where your ideas can take you at Intel.

What You'll Do

Build technologies that power the future of computing. As a Software Engineering Intern, you'll work on meaningful projects while building technical expertise that accelerates your professional growth.



- Design, develop, test, debug, and improve software that enables Intel products and platforms.
- Support code review, high-level design, scripting, automation, and validation activities.
- Contribute to open, secure software platforms and tools.
- Apply programming, data, and systems thinking to solve real engineering challenges.
- Collaborate with hardware, systems, product, and software teams.

Develop technical depth, tackle complex challenges, and contribute from day one while learning alongside experienced Intel engineers and technical leaders.

Where Your Career Could Take You

Potential Opportunity Areas Include



- AI Frameworks Engineer
- Cloud Software Development Engineer
- Firmware Development Engineer
- GPU Software Development Engineer
- Middleware Development Engineer
- Software Application Development Engineer
- Software Research Engineer/Scientist
- System Software Development Engineer
- System Software Validation Engineer

Build technical expertise, explore new possibilities, and help shape what is next in computing and semiconductor technology.

Qualifications

Must possess the minimum qualifications below to be initially considered for this position. Experience may be gained through coursework, research, academic projects, internships, laboratory work, student organizations, leadership experiences, or other relevant experiences.

Minimum Qualifications



- Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related STEM field.
- 3+ months of experience gained through coursework, academic projects, research, internships, co-ops, student organizations, assistantships, or other relevant technical experiences.

Preferred Qualifications



- GPA of 3.0 or higher preferred.
- Experience or interest in design, architecture, programming, scripting, data analysis, automation, modeling, simulation, validation, or debugging.
- Hands-on coursework, research, projects, or internship experience related to the role family.
- Strong problem-solving, communication, collaboration, and ability to work in team-based environments.

Location & Immigration Information

As you consider the opportunity to join Intel, relocation assistance may be available based on eligibility, current location, and the specifics of the role.

Job location and modality of work will be communicated at time of offer. This position is not available in the state of Colorado.

This position is not eligible for employment-based visa/immigration sponsorship.

Intel sponsors individuals for employment-based visas for positions where we experience a shortage of U.S. workers. These skills shortage roles are typically STEM positions requiring a Master's or PhD degree, or a Bachelor's degree with at least three years of post-degree related job experience. This position does not qualify for Intel sponsorship because it is either a non-STEM position, or a STEM position that only requires a Bachelor's degree and less than three years' experience.

For information on Intel's immigration sponsorship guidelines, please see: https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/jobs/hiring.html

This application is for internship starts in Spring and Summer 2027, with consideration also given to candidates interested in year-long internship or co-op opportunities. You must be available to start work during this time frame.

role: Search Safety & Operations Project Intern（TikTok-Platform Responsibility-Search）- 2026 Start
jd:
Responsibilities

TikTok Platform Responsibility Search team is dedicated to building a safer, more trustworthy, and reliable search experience for TikTok's global community.

We proactively identify and mitigate emerging risks across the search ecosystem, combining data-driven strategies, AI-powered solutions, and cross-functional collaboration to address evolving content safety challenges. Working closely with Product, Policy, Engineering, and Operations teams, we develop scalable governance frameworks, strengthen risk detection and response capabilities, and continuously improve the quality and effectiveness of search safety solutions.

Our mission is to protect user trust, uphold platform integrity, and empower safe and responsible content discovery at global scale.

As a Project Intern, you will contribute to impactful short-term projects and gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced, professional environment. This internship offers the opportunity to develop practical skills, apply your knowledge to real-world challenges, and explore your career interests.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early.

Successful candidates must be able to commit to 5 days on-site per week and at least 3 months long internship period, with immediate availability preferred.

Responsibilities:



-  Own search safety operations in the US market, including risk identification, risk mitigation, and public sentiment management. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including Policy, Product Governance (PG), Government Relations (GR), and Operations (OPS), to define risks associated with major events and emerging public concerns, align on governance objectives and mitigation approaches, and drive the implementation and effectiveness evaluation of relevant product features and safety strategies.
-  Conduct proactive risk monitoring, respond to escalations and feedback, assess potential risks, and implement appropriate mitigation strategies. Monitor and respond to emerging social media incidents, trending topics, and public sentiment risks in the US market.
-  Partner closely with the Rapid Response team on day-to-day operations, supporting request execution, issue investigation, strategy reviews, data analysis, and access approval processes.
-  Collaborate with US Content Moderation Operations teams to drive the implementation of safety-related models, data annotation processes, and governance strategies. Monitor and evaluate moderation quality, model performance, and strategy effectiveness in the US market.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications



-  Currently pursuing an Undergraduate related discipline.
-  Strong cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to clearly communicate requirements, align on solutions, and drive project execution across different teams and functions.
-  Good understanding of social media platforms and content-driven products, with the ability to identify and assess potential content safety risks and emerging platform challenges. Good awareness of global public discourse, international politics, and emerging social issues, with sound judgment and a genuine interest in platform safety, risk management, and public sentiment governance.
-  Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with a results-oriented mindset and the ability to translate insights into actionable solutions. Detail-oriented, hands-on, accountable, and capable of driving initiatives through execution.
-  Proven learning agility and adaptability, with the ability to quickly understand new business domains, navigate complex organizational structures, and leverage emerging technologies such as large language models (LLMs). Ability to manage risks, navigate conflicts, and operate effectively in high-pressure environments.
-  Fluency in written and spoken Chinese is needed to manage stakeholders in China market.

Preferred Qualifications:



-  Prior experience in content operations, strategy operations, or related functions within social media platforms, content-driven products, or internet companies is preferred.
-  Experience in search, recommendation systems, platform safety, content governance, or public sentiment management for global digital platforms is preferred.
-  Experience with LLM applications, model optimization, AI agent development, workflow automation, or model performance evaluation is a plus.

Job Information

【For Pay Transparency】Compensation Description (Hourly) - Campus Intern

The hourly rate range for this position in the selected city is $25- $25.

Benefits may vary depending on the nature of employment and the country work location. Interns have day one access to health insurance, life insurance, wellbeing benefits and more. Interns also receive 10 paid holidays per year and paid sick time (56 hours if hired in first half of year, 40 if hired in second half of year). Interns who are not working 100% remote may also be eligible for housing allowance.

The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice.

For Los Angeles County (unincorporated) Candidates:

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Our company believes that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship on the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment:



-  Interacting and occasionally having unsupervised contact with internal/external clients and/or colleagues;
-  Appropriately handling and managing confidential information including proprietary and trade secret information and access to information technology systems; and
-  Exercising sound judgment.

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

TikTok Accommodation

TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

Job Summary

 We are seeking a motivated and tech-savvy college student to join the E-Series engineering team as a part-time student contractor. The selected candidate will play a crucial role in maintaining our datacenter, executing tests, and writing automation scripts, which is integral to the E-Series product line. This position offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience, develop professional skills, being part of an engineering team, and understand the intricacies of product development and deployment in a real-world setting.

  

 Key Responsibilities

 
 Collaborate with scrum teams and test engineers to construct and maintain hardware configurations.

 Assist in validating customer use cases and ensuring the seamless integration of new features.

 Participate in the management of our lab environment, including equipment setup and troubleshooting.

 Contribute to the development and refinement of our automated testing processes.

 Execute manual and automated tests.

 Engage in continuous learning to stay updated with the latest industry practices and technologies.

 

 Job Requirements

 
 Proficiency or familiarity with Linux and Windows operating systems

 Experience with scripting languages such as Python, Perl, or Bash

 Familiarity with programming tools like Git, Jenkins, BitBucket, and VSCode

 Knowledge of monitoring and configuration management tools, such as Ansible

 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen eye for detail

 Excellent communication and teamwork abilities, with a willingness to learn and contribute to a dynamicwork environment

 Availability to work part-time for 20 hours per week, 5 days a week

 

 Education

 Must be enrolled in an educational or professional program.
